title: Othniel, Ehud, and Shamgar

questions.question: Who was the first deliverer the Lord raised up?
questions.explanation: Judges 3:9 (ESV): "...the LoRD raised up a deliverer for the people of Israel... Othniel the son of Kenaz..."

questions.question: Who was the left-handed deliverer?
questions.explanation: Judges 3:15 (ESV): "...Ehud, the son of Gera, the Benjaminite, a left-handed man."

questions.question: Who was the very fat king of Moab?
questions.explanation: Judges 3:17 (ESV): "...Now Eglon was a very fat man."

questions.question: How did Ehud kill Eglon?
options: Thrust a sword into his belly
questions.correctAnswer: Thrust a sword into his belly
questions.explanation: Judges 3:21 (ESV): "And Ehud reached with his left hand, took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly."

questions.question: Who killed 600 Philistines with an oxgoad?
questions.explanation: Judges 3:31 (ESV): "After him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who killed 600 of the Philistines with an oxgoad..."

questions.question: How long did the land have rest under Othniel?
questions.explanation: Judges 3:11 (ESV): "So the land had rest forty years. Then Othniel the son of Kenaz died."

questions.question: From whom did Israel intermarry in this chapter?
options: Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites
questions.correctAnswer: Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites
questions.explanation: Judges 3:5-6 (ESV): "So the people of Israel lived among the Canaanites... And their daughters they took to themselves for wives..."

questions.question: To whom did the Lord sell Israel first?
questions.explanation: Judges 3:8 (ESV): "...he sold them into the hand of Cushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia..."

questions.question: What did Ehud say to Eglon to get a private meeting?
options: I have a secret message for you, O king
questions.correctAnswer: I have a secret message for you, O king
questions.explanation: Judges 3:19 (ESV): "...and said, 'I have a secret message for you, O king.'"

questions.question: Where did Ehud make his escape to?
questions.explanation: Judges 3:26 (ESV): "Ehud escaped while they delayed... and escaped to Seirah."

questions.question: How long did Israel serve Cushan-rishathaim?
questions.explanation: Judges 3:8 (ESV): "...and the people of Israel served Cushan-rishathaim eight years."

questions.question: How long did Israel serve Eglon?
questions.explanation: Judges 3:14 (ESV): "And the people of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years."

questions.question: What did the servants think Eglon was doing when the doors were locked?
questions.explanation: Judges 3:24 (ESV): "...they said, 'He is only relieving himself in the closet of the cool chamber.'"

questions.question: Where were the "idols" (or sculptured stones) mentioned in Ehud's journey?
questions.explanation: Judges 3:19 (ESV): "But he himself turned back at the idols near Gilgal..."

questions.question: What happened to the handle of the sword?
options: It went in after the blade and the fat closed over it
questions.correctAnswer: It went in after the blade and the fat closed over it
questions.explanation: Judges 3:22 (ESV): "And the hilt also went in after the blade, and the fat closed over the blade..."

key_verse_text: After him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who killed 600 of the Philistines with an oxgoad, and he also saved Israel. (ESV)
